newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Texas Instruments EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Texas Instruments EPS cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Erika Klauer reduced her earnings estimate for Texas Instruments Inc to $2.50 per share from $3.15 in 1997.
-- cited concern that company's depreciation costs will grow sharply in 1997 and will "significantly" erode margins.
-- kept 1996 earnings estimate at $1.75, and kept the stock rated a hold.
-- sees stock trading in range of $45-$55 over the next 12 months. Shares rose one to 53-1/4.
